Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Juan Pablo Montoya as the 1998 champion of the Toyota Grand Prix of Long Beach without verifying this claim with authoritative and reliable sources. This critical error in the very first step set the entire task on the wrong trajectory, leading to multiple redundant and ineffective queries aimed at confirming subsequent details about Montoya instead of the actual champion (Alex Zanardi). This error matches the pattern observed in Example 1, where the Planner failed to reconcile conflicting evidence and prematurely accepted incorrect information without appropriate verification.
